regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours these unsettled days - at once of threatening forebodings and of God's outstanding mercies. Rt. Rev. Monsignor Edward is about to leave for Ft. Wayne here since yesterday P.M. He looks well and still seems pushing as usual. I have started several times these later months to write you but, God helps! I hardly know where - 15-19 hour days go to -- Fr. Ed. is going now to New York.
